To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we can automatically identify explained and assumed terms, and use these to find paths from a user’s prior knowledge to their desired learning goal.
we have designed a system that uses supervised classification and graph algorithms to find optimal paths through the Web that take the user from point A to point B.

1) a shallow supervised classification approach to identify explained and assumed terms works better than a deep approach and 2) a greedy search algorithm that uses a graph of web resources and the classification of terms in each resource is able to find paths that satisfy a user’s learning goal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
curating learning resources on the web to create a learning environment that allows the learner to navigate from their current knowledge to a desired goal.
the task of curating targeted learning paths through the heterogeneous educational resources on today’s web.
the task of finding the best path through a set of heterogeneous learning resources on the web to help the user reach a desired level of understanding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose an approach to organizing heterogeneous educational resources from the web into a structured learning path, and we demonstrate its effectiveness in a real-world setting.
this work is a step towards creating a more intelligent and efficient web.

this paper presents a novel approach to organizing web content in a structured manner, allowing the learner a guided navigation through the web resources that take them from where they are to where they need to be.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel approach to curate a sequence of educational resources on the Web, which can be seen as a web-based alternative to the traditional textbook.
we have created a novel approach to curating targeted learning paths through the web.
we are able to find a set of web resources that are most likely to be useful for a given learning goal and prior knowledge, given a set of web documents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to use a simple classification model to identify the explained and assumed concepts in a text and then use this model to create a structure for the web content akin to a textbook.

the web is a rich source of educational material that can be organized into learning paths that take the reader through a series of resources, each of which is tailored to the learner’s current state of knowledge.

we can use the structure of a web resource to infer what concepts it is teaching, and we can use this information to find a sequence of resources that take the user from their current state of knowledge to the target concept they want to learn.
